description: This file is a PHP script responsible for managing the proxy server settings within the vtiger CRM system. It interacts with the database to retrieve current proxy configurations, processes user input to update or display settings, and renders a Smarty template to show the interface.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine class used to render HTML templates in the vtiger CRM system.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Method called on the Smarty class instance to render the specified template.
